name: Guided360
author: Guided360 contributors (based on Game Glance by Michael Palma)

publish.description: An Xbox 360 style Guide for Steam Game Mode: blade menu with quick settings, performance, downloads, friends & chat, achievements, controller settings, a Media Player (Spotify / YouTube Music) and more. 14 presets (Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo, Steam, Steam Deck) and 8 layouts.
